Brand Voice & Style Guide Generator 1.0.0

- Initial release: Generate a full brand voice and content style guide using four structured prompts.
- Covers brand personality, messaging framework, vocabulary rules, content examples, and complete team training kit.
- Designed for CMOs, agencies, startups, freelancers, SaaS content teams.
- Includes tiered pricing (DIY, DFY, agency) and detailed competitive analysis.
- Outputs ready-to-use documents for audits, messaging, examples, and onboarding/training.
summary: Generates a complete brand voice and style guide including voice audit, messaging framework, content rules, and team training materials for consistent branding.
